object_selection.eligible_endpoint_rule: at least two of the six one-column-at-a-time block orders have every waypoint strictly inside all 70 signed parent brackets
object_selection.selection_rule: minimum endpoint residual-factor-state Hamming distance, then minimum chart index

phase_b_holdout: membership alternation spectrum on the 97224-signature universe

prediction_protocol.phase_a: generate exact wall events for all three registered routes without constructing or inspecting any extension-label history
prediction_protocol.predictor: the route with the fewest exact wall events; break an event-count tie by lexicographically smallest order
prediction_protocol.freeze_gate: commit the predicted order and all three event counts before any phase-b label continuation
prediction_protocol.transfer_success: the frozen predicted route weakly minimizes every nonzero alternation tail among the three held-out routes and is strictly smaller at at least one threshold
prediction_protocol.transfer_refutation: some other registered route has a strictly smaller alternation tail at any threshold
prediction_protocol.secondary_statistics: maximum alternation and transition mass are reported but do not replace the tail criterion

hard_stops: a registered waypoint leaves the strict parent cell
an event isolation interval overlaps its successor
the three routes exceed 25000 total events
phase-b labels are inspected before the prediction freeze commit

claim_boundary.possible_success_status: EXACT_FINITE_FACT after independent replay and prior-art review
claim_boundary.possible_failure_status: REFUTED transfer candidate with the exact held-out counterexample retained
excluded_claims: all endpoints in the row-2599 parent cell
a general equivalence between wall-event count and alternation
any change to the honest 9DVL score
